sources.title: Stress-strain data for vulcanised rubber under various types of deformation
sources.enterprise_use: Provides the classic vulcanized-rubber stress-strain observations used as the first external real-material loading benchmark for E001 finite material curves.
sources.not_claimed: The Treloar measurements, experimental protocols, rubber mechanics, and the existence of nonlinear rubber stress-strain behavior are prior experimental work and are not Enterprise Math inventions.

sources.title: Hyperelastic models for rubber-like materials: consistent tangent operators and suitability for Treloar's data
sources.enterprise_use: Provides an established hyperelastic comparison neighborhood for Treloar data and is the stated transcription lineage for the CSV data reused by the public thermalCANN benchmark repository.
sources.not_claimed: Neo-Hookean, Mooney-Rivlin, Yeoh and other classical hyperelastic constitutive models, their continuum-mechanics interpretation, and their use on Treloar data are established prior engineering mechanics, not Enterprise Math inventions.

sources.title: thermalCANN Treloar benchmark data repository
sources.enterprise_use: Supplies the machine-readable Steinmann-transcribed Treloar uniaxial, pure-shear and equibiaxial CSV files used to make the E001 engineering benchmark reproducible without digitizing figures.
sources.not_claimed: The CSV transcription, thermalCANN model, repository code, and underlying Treloar observations are external assets. Enterprise Math only consumes the published numeric observations for comparative validation.
